name: Clock tower (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Civic clock tower landmark, 8 x 8 m and about 25 m tall: a battered limestone plinth and a 7.2 m square brick shaft with stone quoins and string courses, a timber double door, slit windows, four blank clock faces (bronze bezels, hour marks, hands; no numerals) round the clock room, an open belfry with twin round-arched openings on each side above a parapet, a hung bell, a stone cornice and a patinated copper pyramid spire with a finial. Inside: a switchback stair through the ground hall, two storage levels and the clock room (clock mechanism) up to the belfry lookout.
